facts.text: The user asked whether political tensions between Serb-dominated Republika Srpska and the Bosniak-Croat Federation have affected the lives of ordinary Serbs in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
The user said they had no idea how much the political tensions affected the daily lives of ordinary Serbs.
The user asked whether there is hope for reconciliation and a better future for all people in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
The user said it is good to know that there are efforts towards reconciliation in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
The user hopes that one day all people can live peacefully and prosperously in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
